principles: Capture every production failure with the offending headline and source evidence.
Classify before repairing; do not edit the original incident record.
Add a regression fixture when the failure exposes a reusable decision rule.
Do not close a critical failure until the zero-tolerance suite passes and a human reviews the fix.
Keep unresolved policy decisions open rather than encoding a silent workaround.
required_review: fixture or rationale for no fixture
release_rule: A critical production failure blocks release until contained, corrected, and represented in regression evidence.
